findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, list_appearances · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: get_skill_matrix_method, run_skill_matrix.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, list_appearances · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: get_skill_matrix_method, run_skill_matrix

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
